mapper.select: SELECT p.id group_price_id, p.version, p.group_id, g.group_code, g.group_name, p.spu_id, (SELECT s.id FROM xsy_product_sku s WHERE s.spu_id = p.spu_id AND s.sale_unit = p.sale_unit AND s.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 1) sku_id, sp.name product_name, p.sale_unit, p.unit_price, p.effective_from, p.effective_to, p.updated_at FROM xsy_customer_group_price p LEFT JOIN xsy_customer_group g ON g.id = p.group_id LEFT JOIN xsy_product_spu sp ON sp.id = p.spu_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = FALSE
SELECT id FROM xsy_customer_group WHERE id = #{groupId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id, p.group_id, p.spu_id, p.sale_unit, p.unit_price, p.effective_from, p.effective_to, p.version, p.deleted FROM xsy_customer_group_price p JOIN xsy_customer_group g ON g.id = p.group_id WHERE p.deleted = FALSE AND g.deleted = FALSE AND g.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.group_id = #{groupId} AND p.effective_from <= #{at} AND (p.effective_to IS NULL OR p.effective_to > #{at}) AND p.spu_id IN #{spu} ORDER BY p.effective_from DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_customer_group_price_operation_log (group_price_id, operation_type, operator, before_data, after_data, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{operation}, #{operator}, CAST(#{before,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{operator})
